# Hilary Jeune

Hilary Jeune is the current Deputy of [District 3](https://flow.je/elections/district-3) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2022.

Hilary Jeune has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/hilary-jeune#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 3 with 68.5% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/hilary-jeune/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vUPYiQKiJZA)
  - [2022 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20220820124404/https://www.hilaryjeune.com/manifesto)
  - [2022 Jersey Evangelical Alliance Survey](https://www.jerseyevangelicalalliance.org.je/s/Hilary-Jeune-Deputy-St-John-St-Lawrence-and-Trinity-JEA-Questionnaire.pdf)
  - [2022 SCOOP Food Security Questionnaire](https://drive.google.com/uc?export=view&id=1kI5ESEJ4byHHwSp76kLGeBkayQSQynP9#page=5)

Hilary Jeune has declared her intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 3](https://flow.je/elections/district-3). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/07/sitting-deputy-to-seek-re-election/)\]
